_readme: Computed dish-level nutrition. Every dish exposes per_100g (scale to any portion) plus default_serving (the recipe's own typical portion) and, where relevant, named portion_presets. Derived from ingredients.json + recipes.json via build_dishes.py — see that script and README.md for methodology. Estimates, not lab measurements.
